items.quote: And Moses and Aaron came in unto Pharaoh
items.claim: Moses and Aaron entered Pharaoh's presence

items.quote: and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, How long wilt thou refuse to humble thyself before me? let my people go, that they may serve me
items.claim: Moses and Aaron conveyed to Pharaoh the LORD's demand to release His people

items.quote: How long wilt thou refuse to humble thyself before me?
items.claim: Pharaoh refuses to humble himself before God

items.quote: Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, How long wilt thou refuse to humble thyself before me? let my people go, that they may serve me
items.claim: The LORD God demands release of the Hebrew people
items.actor: the LORD God of the Hebrews
